prompt:
Create one production sprite atlas for NPC073's guarded/skeptical speech mouths, using the supplied exact 3×3 repeated-original-lower-half grid as the only reference image.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native pixel-art portrait mouth atlas
Primary request: Create nine subtle, believable guarded visemes. Mouth tension is restrained and appraising, not angry and not smiling.
Composition: Exactly three equal columns and rows, each a complete lower 64×29 crop; whole atlas has 64:29 cell proportions. Row-major A B C / D E F / G H X. No labels, gutters, borders, extra panels, full-face views, or independent mouth closeups.
Subject and style: Preserve NPC073 identity, original muted skin and nose, hair, blue wand at left, chin/neck, framing, and lip scale. Preserve source's soft pink/terracotta lip color. Crisp native pixel art with low contrast.
Pose details:
A: pressured closed P/B/M.
B: narrow opening, teeth nearly together, consonants/EE.
C: medium unrounded EH/AE.
D: wide AA.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER, no wider than C.
F: puckered UW/OW/W.
G: upper teeth touching lower lip, F/V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle.
Keep guarded tension subtle in corners and lip shape without erasing each phoneme pose. Gray-ivory teeth must read distinct from skin; use modest cavity contrast and no tooth gaps. Only show teeth for poses that require them.
Avoid: lipstick-red lips, skin-colored teeth, bright shiny white flashes, pure white teeth, oversized mouths, black outlines, exaggerated smirk or downturned corners, giant skin patches, changed nose/jaw/hair/neck, blur or smoothing.
